name: device.operating-system.supplemental.build-version
title: Status Device Operating System Supplemental Build Version
description: The status item that reports the device's operating system supplemental build version and Background Security Improvement version.

payloadkeys.title: Status item value.
payloadkeys.content: The operating system's build and Background Security Improvement versions in use on the device, for example, `20A123a` or `20B27c`.
